title: Countries we sell to
statementMd:
List each customer country once.

Expected columns: `country`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM customers;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
